quest.title: To Each Their Duty
quest.description: Even though rocks are falling from the skies, some Knights of Favonius are still attending to their duties outside the city. Huffman is rather worried about these knights...
quest.rewards_formatted: Fading Star's Might x20, Primogem x40, Mora x25000

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll get it to them.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: Hello. Do you require anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here's some Orders for you...

dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: Orders? Oh my. Let me have a look... Instructions to return to the city and help to settle various matters...

dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: Um, so, I could go back to the city, but those two children simply don't want to do the same.

dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: I have no idea where their parents have gone, and I don't want to forcibly bring them back, so I've been stuck here guarding them.

dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: If I were to head back under these circumstances, I don't know what I'd do if something happened to them.

dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: But I've tried several times to persuade them, and now they won't listen to me at all.

dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: So... could you help me convince them? Maybe they might listen to you instead.

dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: If you can convince them to return to the city, then I too can leave in peace.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll give it a shot.

dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: Great, thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Jill
dialogues.text: Hmm? Is something wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, here's the situation...

dialogues.speaker: Jill
dialogues.text: Oh, I know about the meteorites. But... we haven't seen what they look like when they're coming down.

dialogues.speaker: Jill
dialogues.text: Will said he knew a good spot to watch them, so we came here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You can see them from the city too...

dialogues.speaker: Jill
dialogues.text: But we'd need to go somewhere really high up to see them if we were in the city.

dialogues.speaker: Jill
dialogues.text: The guards aren't going to let us to get up that high for sure...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That nice man over there is willing to help.

dialogues.speaker: Jill
dialogues.text: Eh? You mean that weird old guy there? But the last time he came to talk to us, he looked really nasty.

dialogues.speaker: Jill
dialogues.text: He just wanted us to go back. Didn't say anything else at all...

dialogues.speaker: Jill
dialogues.text: But if he agrees to take us to a really high place to watch the meteorites, I think... I think we can go back.

dialogues.speaker: Jill
dialogues.text: But you'd best talk to Will. It was his idea, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Will
dialogues.text: Hmm? Hello, is something up?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, here's the situation...

dialogues.speaker: Will
dialogues.text: I know, that's why we came out here — to see the meteorites. Don't worry, we'll go back once we've seen them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You can see them from the city too...

dialogues.speaker: Will
dialogues.text: But then we'd need to get way up high. I tried lots of times, but the guards kept yelling at me to come down. I got a scolding from them afterwards.

dialogues.speaker: Will
dialogues.text: That's why I brought Jill over here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That nice guard over there will help us out.

dialogues.speaker: Will
dialogues.text: Help us? Do you mean he can take us to a high point in the city to watch the meteorites?

dialogues.speaker: Will
dialogues.text: That can't be... He looks so weird, and angry, too...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have his Orders with me.

dialogues.speaker: Will
dialogues.text: Really? Let me see them! Wow... these really are the official Orders of the Knights!

dialogues.speaker: Will
dialogues.text: With this, that man will take us up to see the meteorites, won't he?

dialogues.speaker: Will
dialogues.text: Hehe... Watching the meteorites from inside the city would be the best!

dialogues.speaker: Will
dialogues.text: Well, you go have a word with him. I'll talk to Jill.

dialogues.speaker: Will
dialogues.text: Ah, I really can't wait... I wanna see the meteorites falling.

dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: How did it go? Did you manage to convince them?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, so it would seem...

dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: Really? That's great! Thank you so much— actually, wait... What do you mean "so it would seem"?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You just need to do your part...

dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: My part? What does that mean...

dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: Eh? You want me to take them to the highest point in Mondstadt and watch the meteors fall? That's... rather dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: Not to mention that they're kids, too. I'll have to report this to Headquarters first...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got your Orders right here, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: That's... not how you use it, I don't think.

dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: Well, never mind. As long as we can get those kids back to the city, I'll... I'll figure something out.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Really?

dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: Of course, I swear it on my honor as a knight and... as an adult.

dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: No matter who it is, our word is as good as our bond.

dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: Thanks for your help. Leave the rest to me — I'll bring them back to the city shortly.

dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: Afterwards, I'll figure out how to get them to Mondstadt's highest point...

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: Hello. Do you need help with anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have a look at these Orders...

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: Orders? Allow me... So, instructions to return to the city, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: My apologies, but I will have to execute these duties later, as I still have important matters to attend to.

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: It seems as if the monsters around these parts have been affected by the meteorites. They've become much more violent, and are exceptionally dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: I have to clean them out in order to ensure this area's safety.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But there's no one here, is there?

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: Well, it's precisely because no one's around that I'm free to fight these monsters.

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: This is a very important matter. I cannot leave while it remains undone.

response.speaker: Harry
response.text: Great, thank you. There's not one, but a few concentrations of monsters in this area.

response.speaker: Harry
response.text: Let's split up and destroy all the monsters in our respective areas, and we'll link up here once we're done.

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: Those monsters were really hard to handle...

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: I've settled matters on my end. How goes it on yours?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're done here as well.

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: Haha, you've got fine moves, don't you? Thanks so much for your help. I don't think those monsters will return to these parts for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: Still, I can't return just yet. Other than these monsters, there are still more roaming about in the Stormbearer Mountains.

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: I want to continue gathering intelligence here — and if someone were to come to harm nearby, I would be on hand to rescue them.

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: Not everyone is aware of the call to seek shelter, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: Alright, then. Please convey my intent to Mr. Huffman. I'm sure he'll understand.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Ah, right, I've made you run about quite a bit, and in these conditions, too. I must thank you properly.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Here, take these as thanks. If you haven't any other urgent matters, please stay within the city limits.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: *sigh* It seems that we don't have any good options...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Something the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you. Well... I'm sure you've seen those falling meteorites.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: While the city itself has been very fortunate to have avoided any meteorite hits, it's chaos outside.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Between the people who fled into the city to seek shelter and those who fell unconscious without warning, we've got our hands full here.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: I'd like to recall all the knights who are currently attending to duties outside so we can settle matters within these four walls first.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: But they are currently dispersed out in the wild, and we haven't the extra numbers to go out and look for them.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Could you lend me a hand and let them have a look at these Orders?

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: So, how has it gone? Have they all seen the Orders?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They did, but...

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: "But"? Did something happen?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I still have matters to attend to.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Alright. I'll find someone else... or think of another way.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: It's fortunate that none of the meteorites struck the city...

dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: Really, those two kids — going out to play at a time like this...

dialogues.speaker: Jill
dialogues.text: That man is really weird. He follows us everywhere, and he sounds so fierce, too...

dialogues.speaker: Will
dialogues.text: I wonder what meteorites falling from the sky are gonna look like...

dialogues.speaker: Mack
dialogues.text: Hmm... Where would the highest point in Mondstadt be?

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: Oh, I'll be heading out soon. You go first. Once we've both completed our work, we'll meet back here.

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: We have to be on our guard against those monsters...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about Mack...

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Oh, he needs to take the kids to the highest point in Mondstadt to watch the meteorites? Haha, that's fine. That's fine.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: As long as they come back safely, Mack just needs to report what happens to me.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Mack's never been good with children. This must have been quite the ride for him.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: As for Harry...

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Harry... still wants to stand guard in the Stormbearer Mountains?

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Hmmm, well, that's fine. If anything were to suddenly occur there, he should be able to report back quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: But he can be a bit impulsive. I hope that he can settle this with no mess.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: As for Harry...

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Harry... still wants to stand guard in the Stormbearer Mountains?

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Hmmm, well, that's fine. If anything were to suddenly occur there, he should be able to report back quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: But he can be a bit impulsive. I hope that he can settle this with no mess.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about Mack...

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Oh, he needs to take the kids to the highest point in Mondstadt to watch the meteorites? Haha, that's fine. That's fine.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: As long as they come back safely, Mack just needs to report what happens to me.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Mack's never been good with children. This must have been quite the ride for him.
